title: Fierce Fish
note: 상어의 크기, 먹이, 종류를 사진과 함께 소개하는 K1 기사

paragraphs: Imagine a shark. What do you think of? Sharks come in all shapes and sizes. Some are big. Some are small. Some are fast and powerful. Others are calm and slow. Here are some shark facts.
They are at the top of the food chain. They eat other animals. These include big fish, like this tuna.
There are more than 400 species of sharks. This is a hammerhead shark. See the shape of its head?
Sharks may bite people. But this is rare. Humans are not part of their normal diet. They prefer fish.
This is a great white shark. It can leap out of the water. This helps it catch food, like seals.

questions.q: How many species of sharks are there?
What do sharks prefer to eat?
Where are sharks in the food chain?
What can a great white shark do to catch food?
questions.answer: It can leap out of the water.
questions.note: "jump out of the water" 처럼 써도 정답으로 봐주세요.

questions.q: Are all sharks the same size? Write your answer in one sentence.
questions.answer: No. Some are big and some are small.
questions.note: 첫 문단의 shapes and sizes 부분을 읽었는지 보는 문항입니다.

writing.prompt: Write one thing you learned about sharks.
writing.sample: 학생마다 답이 다릅니다. 기사에 나온 사실을 한 문장으로 썼는지 확인해 주세요.
